description: Attributed analyst skill claims (Nerd Sesh position top-10s, redraft and opening-week episodes, Jul-Oct 2026), paraphrased from the transcript extractions in docs/ratings-evidence-2026-10-29/. Read by src/nba_gm_data/analyst_evidence.py. Paraphrases only; timestamps are the extraction section ranges. Edit by hand: add a claim with its source, or set not_applied with a reason.
